name: Gotchi Galaxy
subtitle: Pixel-art pocket pets

apps.name: Gotchi Galaxy
apps.subtitle: A pocket pet for your phone
apps.localizedDescription: A pixel-art pocket pet you raise, breed and take to far-away planets.

versions.localizedDescription:
- The trip porthole sits at the top right: tap it to look in on your pet
- Hearts and little icons sit in the middle of the thought bubble

- The trip porthole shows whoever is home; swipe to see each pet that is out
- At night with the lights on, your room stays bright; lights off puts the candles out
- The square reconnects by itself and keeps your place
- Grown-ups can turn off sharing play counts

- One Daily list: five small things a day, Star Miles for each, the shop inside
- Long menu lines slide so you can read them all
- Quiet hours slow needs only: pets keep growing
- On holiday, the Daily list wishes you a good one

- Walk with me: on a phone, your day's steps make the next trip faster
- Today's list: a few small things a day, then you're done
- Feed and play reach every pet at once; grown pets need less
- Grown-ups settings: play time limit, quiet hours, fake calls off
- Back after a while? A visitor may wait in the garden
- New games: Bomb Miner, Follow the Leader, duels and a rhythm stage show
- Share a picture of the game or your pet's diary
- Game coins slow down after a busy day

- Every furniture set redrawn: ten pieces each, arranged like a real room
- New set: the Apricot Parlour. Two pets on its sofa grow closer
- New sets for the garden: the Fairy Ring Garden and the Garden Stage; the beds are redrawn
- Each pet has a wish of the day
- Make friends on the square; friends can start a family
- Visit a friend's room and leave a sticker on their window
- All together party rounds, and sets show where to find a missing piece

- Two new furniture sets: the Cloud Nursery (eggs hatch sooner) and the Sweet Bakery (treats cheer more)
- Memory duels at the Market table: play another player, or Chirpy
- Chirpy's stage show: one show a day, clap your pets to an encore
- Sleepovers: a friend's pet stays the night, and you both keep the photo
- Besties hold hands on the bench, a Spotlight hat, and an easier way round the square

- Furniture sets: the Little Lab, six pieces with its own wallpaper and floor. Finish a set in one room for its look and a perk
- Rooms hold 10 pieces; small ones sit on tops
- Friends online: swap friend codes to send visits, gifts and waves anywhere
- Party rounds on the square every 10 minutes: one game for all, a podium and coins
- Market Finds, the Plaza ribbon, wings that flap again

- Care routes: how you raise a child and teen picks the adult (Star, Sweet Tooth, Free Spirit, Polite, Scrappy, Dreamy), with its own face, mark and perk
- Raised with care, a grumpy kid can grow up sweet. Fill each species' Routes page in the dex
- The square at full pet size, redrawn, with other players' pets live and stickers
- Befriend the square's residents for gifts; Play nearby opens LAN play
- Fixes: bench seats, the square's sky, smoother on slow phones, no blank screen after waking

- The town square: the social button opens a square to stroll, with a fountain, benches, stalls and residents to meet
- Wish at the fountain daily; 7 days in a row brings a lucky wish and a Wishing Well for your garden
- A weekly game board, a ticket trader open every day, and a flower cart that buys your blooms
- Cosy evenings: lamps light the room after dark, and a new Floor Lamp in the shop
- Fixes: planet natives fit their card; the Focus note no longer covers the lamp

- New furniture: a rocking chair, a toy chest, a striped hammock and a flower arch
- Moving to a new device keeps the old island for 7 days, in case you want it back
- Festival weekends: the Festival sits near the top of the menu, and tickets earned offline all reach the shared goal
- Fixes: a wall picture no longer disappears when the back of the room is full; New Year Glasses are now Party Glasses
